name: Tyler Williams
source: A graphic designer and painter in the Fine Arts department, Tyler is highly skilled in anything involving visuals, thanks to his photographic memory. Tyler loves to be the center of attention! He is an artist from head to toe: charming, sensitive, creative… and highly critical of himself. Despite being very different, Tyler and Tegan make an incredible team, and being their friend comes with a lot of advantages!
